description: Clinical bands for the AWS side: patient-vitals scores every reading with these, and the alert dispatcher decides CRITICAL_VITALS or ABNORMAL_TREND with them. scripts/deploy-aws.sh copies this file to the SSM parameter /cloud-agentic-iot/config/vital-thresholds, which the Lambdas read at runtime. Salesforce holds the same numbers as Vital_Sign_Threshold__mdt records plus the score fields on Device_Platform_Setting__mdt.Default; test/config/thresholds-match.test.js fails the checks when the two differ. A value is critical when it is below critical.below or above critical.above, otherwise a warning when it is outside the warning limits. Limits are strict: a value equal to a limit is inside the band.
